correctness.rationale: For each prescribed vertex partition, Cayley factorization gives one joining edge and independent uniform internal trees with uniform independent endpoints. Prüfer leaf probabilities yield exactly g(k)+g(n-k), including singleton and equal-split multiplicity boundaries. A rigorous concavity/power-series inequality shows every nontrivial covariance strictly negative; pendant covariance is a positive leaf-count variance for all n>=4. The conditional macroscopic deficit follows from derived expansions. Exhaustive exact rational verification covers 280392 trees and 11014 checks; finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Leafiness measures local branching, while the vertex-based split spectrum measures failure fragmentation. Their finite covariance and uniform sign boundary are not determined by separate means. The statement classifies all split sizes in one natural probability model and includes a scale-independent conditional deficit for macroscopic splits, with no arbitrary slice or required downstream theorem.
